_about: Jobs that run on their own, listed on Backstage › Global › Development › Scheduled (app/fft/work_page.py; The Work Pages, Nov 20). Each reports its run with POST /api/fft/jobs/<key> (Claude's key reports any; the Mac Mini's and GitHub's only their own, app/fft/keys.py JOBS_OF; scripts/feedback.py job <key> ok|failed "what it found"). every_hours: a run older than one and a half times this is Late. does, checks, fails: what its side panel says (issue 55, Brett, Nov 20: a description of each). reads: where else its runs are kept (backup: the job_runs table); "elsewhere": it doesn't report here (Dependabot: its pull requests reach Claude), so it's never Late, and link says where to see it. The jobs audit (Brett's picks, Nov 21, docs/mockups/jobs-audit/) chose which run and how often.

jobs.title: The live test
jobs.what: Part 1 on the real D&D Beyond, then through the DM
jobs.does: Opens the three test seats on the real D&D Beyond and runs part 1 of the live test against askdnd.ai: a closed sheet, hit points, conditions, casting, rests, items and more, each changed in askdnd and read back on D&D Beyond; then the same again through the DM. Its sheets are tidied after every run.
jobs.checks: That what askdnd changes reaches D&D Beyond and comes back, on real accounts, as the table plays.
jobs.fails: A run that misses is tried once more; missed twice becomes an issue in Sentry (environment live-test), which alerts you. A night it doesn't report shows here as Late.

jobs.title: After each deploy
jobs.what: Four short runs of the live test against the new version
jobs.does: Every 5 minutes the Mac Mini asks askdnd.ai which version it runs; when it changes, it opens the test seats and runs four short parts of the live test (a closed sheet, hit points, a condition, a cast) against the new version.
jobs.checks: That a deploy didn't break the table's way to D&D Beyond: a change made in askdnd reaches D&D Beyond and comes back.
jobs.fails: A miss goes to Sentry as "Live test after deploying …", which alerts you, and it reports Failed here. It's Late only after a week without a deploy it checked.

jobs.title: iPhone Safari
jobs.what: The seats' pages in real iPhone and iPad Safari
jobs.does: While the seats are open after the live test, opens the DM's and a player's pages in Apple's iPhone and iPad Simulator, in real Safari: a small iPhone, a large one and an iPad mini.
jobs.checks: Safari's own bars, the keyboard, tapping a text box, and pages that fit: what desktop browsers can't show.
jobs.fails: What it finds goes to Sentry as "iPhone Safari: … missed", which alerts you.

jobs.title: D&D Beyond drift
jobs.what: Today's test sheets against the fixtures' shape
jobs.does: GitHub reads today's three test sheets from D&D Beyond as askdnd does and compares them with the copies the tests use.
jobs.checks: That a field the copies have isn't gone or changed kind, and that askdnd's parser still reads every character whole (name, level, Hit Points, AC, abilities, saves, skills, classes, actions, items, spells).
jobs.fails: The run fails, GitHub emails you, and it reports Failed here with its own key (one that may report only this job); Claude refreshes the copies and fixes the parser.

jobs.title: Backups
jobs.does: Railway's backup service copies askdnd.ai's database to S3 every night, then sweeps files nothing has used for longer than backups are kept (its run line counts what it removed).
jobs.checks: That a whole copy was made and stored; staging is refreshed from these copies.
jobs.fails: Manage's Overview flags a failed or missed night; here it shows as Failed or Late.

jobs.title: Restore drill
jobs.what: The newest backup loaded into staging, to prove it restores
jobs.does: A scheduled Claude session on the 1st of each month loads the newest nightly backup into staging (scripts/refresh_staging.sh) and opens staging to see it answers with that data.
jobs.checks: That a backup isn't only made but can be restored: the whole database comes back and askdnd runs on it.
jobs.fails: It reports Failed here with what went wrong, and Claude looks before the next backup is needed. Staging is all it touches; askdnd.ai never is.

jobs.title: The Inbox digest
jobs.what: An email to each person with something waiting for them
jobs.does: Once a day, past the digest's hour, askdnd looks at each campaign for each person who gets the digest and emails those with something new in its Inbox.
jobs.checks: That what's waiting for the DM and reviewers (the table's suggestions, Claude's drafts) reaches them without opening askdnd.
jobs.fails: An email that doesn't go out is tried again at its next look, and the day is reported here as Failed with how many; a day it doesn't look shows as Late.

jobs.title: New notes
jobs.what: Sorts what came in overnight against what's merged
jobs.does: A scheduled Claude session each morning reads what came in overnight against what's merged and what the code does now. On a morning when nothing came in, it reports that and stops.
jobs.checks: That nothing you or the table sent waits unread, and that a note about something already fixed says so.
jobs.fails: It reports each morning here, an empty one included; a morning it doesn't run shows as Late. It changes nothing without your OK.

jobs.title: Slowest pages
jobs.what: Each page's time on askdnd.ai this week; a slow one becomes an issue (Behind the scenes › Speed)
jobs.does: askdnd keeps every page's time on askdnd.ai each day; on Mondays it reads the week.
jobs.checks: Each page whose slowest tenth takes 0.8 s or more, asked at least 20 times in the week.
jobs.fails: A slow page becomes an issue under Behind the scenes › Speed, kept up to date while it's open.

jobs.title: The phone sweep
jobs.what: Every page at 375 and 768 as admin, DM and player; one pull request
jobs.does: A scheduled Claude session every Monday looks at every page at phone and tablet widths as the admin, the DM and a player.
jobs.checks: Anything that scrolls sideways, spills, overlaps, wraps a one-line control or is hard to tap.
jobs.fails: Every finding is fixed in one pull request, and a check for your iPhone comes to For you; the session reports its run here, and a Monday it doesn't run shows as Late.

jobs.title: Errors filed from Sentry
jobs.what: New errors at the table, filed as issues
jobs.does: Asks Sentry, with a read-only key, for errors first seen in the last two days that aren't resolved, and files each new one as an issue in Behind the scenes › Errors, with how often it happened and its Sentry link.
jobs.checks: That an error a player hits reaches the Board and Claude, not only Sentry's own alerts.
jobs.fails: Sentry not answering shows here as failed; askdnd tries again the next day. Off until the read-only key is set.

jobs.title: Dependabot
jobs.what: Updates to the libraries askdnd uses, as pull requests
jobs.does: GitHub's Dependabot opens a pull request each week for each library with a newer version.
jobs.checks: That askdnd doesn't fall behind on fixes and security updates in the code it builds on.
jobs.fails: Its pull requests reach Claude, who merges them when the tests pass (a major version gets a real check first). It doesn't report here, so it's never Late; its pull requests are on GitHub.
